chunk.content: Bandeng presto (pressurized milkfish) is a well-known product of Pati Regency, one of the largest milkfish producers in Central Java Province; the article characterises the bandeng presto processing chain at small-and-medium-enterprise scale.
chunk.source_quote: Pati Regency is one of the largest milkfish producers in Central Java Province with one well known product is pressurized milkfish.

source.title: Karakteristik Proses Pengolahan Bandeng (Chanos chanos) Presto Skala UMKM di Kecamatan Juwana, Kabupaten Pati
